description: This file defines the XmlErrorRenderer class, which generates XML formatted error messages for the Slim framework, including detailed exception information when debug mode is enabled.

classes.name: XmlErrorRenderer
classes.description: A renderer class responsible for converting error exceptions into XML format, optionally including detailed information about the exception.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Handles an exception and returns its XML representation, including optional detailed information based on the displayErrorDetails flag.

methods.name: createCdataSection
methods.description: Creates a CDATA section for safe inclusion of message content in XML, replacing ']]>' sequences to prevent XML parsing errors.
